pull.title: KAFKA-21181: Return NOT_COORDINATOR from a stale transaction coordinator cache (4.1)
pull.body:
Backport of #23630 to 4.1 (cherry-pick of
9dfd65db3d5bb3297f29a4a5dea4207658511cd9).

After a broker loses leadership of a `__transaction_state` partition,
its `TransactionStateManager` keeps the partition's cache entry until
`TransactionCoordinator.onResignation` runs, which happens after the
replica has already become a follower. Answers decided purely from that
cache are never fenced, so a TV2 EndTxn(COMMIT) that lands in this
window can get a fatal `INVALID_TXN_STATE` instead of `NOT_COORDINATOR`.
This only uses a cache entry while the local replica still leads the
partition at the entry's coordinator epoch, and returns
`NOT_COORDINATOR` otherwise so the client rediscovers the new
coordinator.

**Backport notes:** the production change is identical to trunk; only
tests were adapted. Same `prepareForTxnMessageAppend` resolution as 4.2.
The new tests also use Scala collections, which 4.1's
`TransactionMetadata`, `prepareAddPartitions`,
`handleVerifyPartitionsInTransaction` and
`handleAddPartitionsToTransaction` take.

**Testing:** `./gradlew :core:test --tests
'kafka.coordinator.transaction.*' :core:checkstyleTest` passes on 4.1,
including the six new tests.
